plugins.description: ZCode Go 桌面接管：在任意会话输入 /zcode-go 切换到 ZCode Go 桌面（底层为官方原生运行时，签名与额度保留）；退出 ZCode Go 重开官方即切回。首个 plugin release 后市场条目自动切为含 OPC 模板包的发布 zip（由 release-plugin 工作流改写本清单）。

description_i18n.en: ZCode Go desktop takeover: type /zcode-go in any session to switch to the ZCode Go desktop (official native runtime underneath, signature and quota preserved); quit ZCode Go and relaunch official ZCode to switch back. After the first plugin release this entry switches to the release zip that ships the OPC template packs (rewritten by the release-plugin workflow).
